name: smwmusic-chronos-zx-spectrum-title-theme
title: Chronos (ZX Spectrum) - Title Theme
description:
Title screen from the ZX Spectrum 48K game, composed by Tim Follin. He managed to software mix a beeper to have 6 channels when he was 15.

Could fit on a title screen or maybe a space level.

A version with the original ending is provided, as well as a looped version.

Original (warning: quite harsh on the ears): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u-D24A_N4d4
